prompt: In §4.1 the textbook uses the word valence by itself, not as part of “valence electrons.” What does it mean there?

options: [0] The capacity of an element's atoms to form chemical bonds.
[1] The number of electrons in an atom's outermost shell.
[2] The charge of the element's most common ion.
[3] The energy needed to remove an atom's outermost electron.
